title: Cost-of-Living Increase and Other Determinations for 2026 (90 FR 49047)

passages.question: What is the Social Security Administration's contribution and benefit base for 2026?
passages.excerpt: Cost-of-Living Increase and Other Determinations for 2026 ... The OASDI contribution and benefit base is $184,500 for remuneration paid in 2026 and self-employment income earned in tax years beginning in 2026. The OASDI contribution and benefit base serves as the maximum annual earnings on which OASDI taxes are paid.
